blocker.summary: The bound Terraform plan was applied and every post-apply gate passed, but the M1-M5 continuation cannot start. The bounded launcher scripts/run_m67_bounded_controlled_egress.py only performs ECS gateway scaling + RunTask; the ECS activator container (opintel_intelligence_worker.sampled_slot_execution_main) requires a valid m67.phase1.sampled-slot-execution-approval@3 SampledSlotExecutionApprovalEnvelope to already be written to /m67-phase1/sampled-slot-execution-approval before it can create the Slot 01 release and work item.
why_operator_cannot_construct_it: No window-2 approval envelope exists in the repository. Only superseded schema-@2 envelopes for earlier windows are present under local-data/m6.7/slot01-v5-*.

No envelope generator or authority-orchestration script exists in tracked scripts/. The only @3 constructions in the codebase are synthetic constants in tests/test_m67_sampled_slot_production_wiring.py.

The @3 envelope must bind, byte-for-byte, fields of the currently stored research-release object: workspace_id, source_registry_id, source_registry_hash, retention_policy_id, retention_policy_hash, environment_id, environment_hash, cohort_policy_id, kill_switch_id. The operator identity is structurally denied ssm:GetParameter on that parameter, so those values cannot be read.

Hand-fabricating a production authority artifact that gates live first-party web egress, from a release object that cannot be read and a schema with no reference instance, would violate the system 'never make stuff up' invariant.
blocker.not_a_repair_trigger: This is not an eligible operational defect within the Window 2 bounded-repair policy. No repair cycle was consumed. It is a missing input to the already-authorized experiment.

needs_owner_input_one_of: The window-2 m67.phase1.sampled-slot-execution-approval@3 approval envelope JSON (approval + approval_artifact_sha256), to be written to /m67-phase1/sampled-slot-execution-approval.
The path/name of the envelope-generator or authority-orchestration tool the prior process used (appears not to be committed to this repository).

An IAM identity or role that can ssm:GetParameter /m67-phase1/research-release and /m67-phase1/sampled-slot-execution-approval, so the operator can read the current release bindings and construct the @3 envelope per docs/contract.
